### Vito Palmisano

**Title:** The Quantum Landscape - State of the Art, Architectures and Installations

**Institution:** Quantum & HPC Engineer, CINECA, Italy

Vito Palmisano is an engineer specializing in Data Science and Quantum Computing
within CINECA's Quantum Computing Lab. He focuses on the integration of quantum
systems with HPC infrastructures, participating in national and European projects
related to benchmarking, software development, and Quantum Machine Learning
applications.
